## How to read this

The first pass is a desk audit: no harness run was done for it. Each status comes from what the repo already records:
[FUNCTION_INVENTORY.md](FUNCTION_INVENTORY.md), [gameplay_function_matrix.json](gameplay_function_matrix.json),
[PHASE_STATUS.md](PHASE_STATUS.md), [LOBBY_FINDINGS.md](LOBBY_FINDINGS.md) and the server code. Admin rows (31–33)
are read from the RoS_Admin console's API client (`packages/api`). The RoS_Server backend is not in this
workspace, so none of those rows are verified.

| Status | Meaning | Counted as |
|---|---|---|
| `PASS` | Verified working on LDPlayer (inventory ✅) | Passed |
| `FAIL` | Not implemented, or known broken | Failed |
| `PARTIAL` | Screen or flow works, but the data is fixed or empty, or it only works in solo | Pending |
| `CODED` | Implemented in code, not yet seen working in game | Pending |
| `CLIENT` | Runs on the client; the server only has to not break it. Not tested on its own | Pending |
| `NOT TESTED` | No evidence either way | Pending |

A `PASS` should be checked again after any change to `ros_server.py`, `loginapp.py` or `battle_flow.py`.
The phone (`R3CM90BCXGJ`) has not been tested for any row. Every `PASS` is LDPlayer only.

**Main blocker:** every client gets its own private `Match`. No other players are created and positions are not relayed. Most `FAIL` rows in 05, 06, 10, 11, 17, 18, 19 and 20 depend on a shared match, or on server-side bots.
